what: Text appears scrambled into number characters, then returns to its place — earlier characters first (each character has a random order, later ones slower). For the first third it is blank, then starts to shuffle so slots fill in like an airport departure board. Default .8s, date slots 2s

options.dur: Full reveal duration (seconds), default 0.8 — Brand menu and section names .8, date field 2, heading 1
options.on: view (default, once when it enters 70% of the screen) · load (right on attach after delay) · hover (every time the pointer is over)
options.each: [data-fx-part=text] delay between items when there are several (sec), default 0
options.chars: Set of characters to shuffle, default 1234567890 (Brand). The library default is ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ1234567890
options.empty: Character to place in slots before they shuffle, default blank (brand). Library default is -
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text to shuffle (children) — if there are several, each is shuffled. If none, the element’s own text is used. Attach to an element that holds only text (line breaks and tags inside turn into text while shuffling)

from.where: shared.js shuffle() — side menu, hero title, vertical section labels, news date cells (2s), menu drawer title
index.js trailer.vtitle (video title, empty slot " ")·spec x card, four English lines (blank "") — the same ShuffleText in the original bundle, duration 600ms·characters A–Z0–9 as is

index.html .a3-list ul — each time the list view opens, the 24 lines of large names are shuffled into place (original setSuffleText("#list .name--pc", 2e3) · same ShuffleText, blanks _ · A–Z). When the view changes, index.js removes data-fx and puts it back so it shuffles from the start
from.use: data-fx-shuffle-text="on: load; dur: 2; chars: ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ; empty: _"
